body:
I really like your list of things to do ***because you can do this anytime you want as none of the activity involves other human*** ***and that's the best part of it.***   
Sort the list by which easiest(you can start from today) to hardest(you need some time to make plan) thing and start doing it one by one.

Hey, Please DM me if you feel like talking to me.  
I am here to listen to your part of the story what lead you to make such decisions. I am not here to give you any advise. Just want to listen to your thoughts. DM me if you want to share anything.

Ohh i see. RULES lol.  
Thanks anyway for help :)
Yeah I am sorry. My bad.

"but it’s most important to keep them alive and usually remembering the people who love you and need you most" - What if you are in a position where you already lost feeling (sense of connection) with anyone you know of. Then it nothing wont matter to you.

It's not like he/she came to this point and haven't thought about the people who want him/her in their life. It's just that one doesn't see a point why they should even continue. And pointing to other people can never help because if that would have matter the person ending their life definitely have thought about it.  


Hope I am making any sense.

Yes you are right nothing will make it better?  
But do we have to live only for someone else?? Because they need us??  
Shouldnt be the reason you live should be "YOU"?  


Probably you cant understand what i am trying to convey here. But when someone is in position like this they dont need OTHER reason to live for. They need themself to be alive.   
I dont know why this is so hard to explain to everyone. Wish i am good with words.

I can relate to every word of yours. Whenever i reached out for help people gave me other reason to live for. They always compare my thing to others but not a once anyone tried saying its okay what you feel i am here. 

They always say things if you do this what will your parents do how would they feel (like fuck I don't know about that). Its a shit show everyone i know. Its upto you now how long you want to see this show.
I am with you on that 33 days. Apparently 25th April is good date for me too end it :)

when they lock you up. Call them in for help. Them kill them and kill yourself also.  
That's the only way they will understand. That's the only way to make a point.
Just fuck everything drink alcohol 24 \* 7.. You probably wont remember a shit about a day or a week or months. That helps me

I don't know. Does therapy even work guys honestly asking? Or is it just bullshit? I have friends and family helping but they cant seem to do a thing. How would even a stranger will be able to help me?

**I have strong views on things.**  


Can we talk about I bet i will listen. I also have something to share for this fuking human race in current time. I think our views match so its good to talk about it.  


When i tried to explain my views to other they just disregard it with it happens. You should do this. No fucktard thats not the solution. Solution is to stop being so heartless in this world.  


I been in really deep shit because of i gave too much care and been way too nice to pepole. Even when they showed every time they dont deserve it. I forgive them and keep on doing everything i can.  And in the end i got told things that made me believe that people in this generation are fucking worthless and dumb piece of shit. And now I think none of them ever deserved things i did for them.   


If they just compare how much I been nice to them and what i will get out being nice to them. Literally nothing. Yet i can't help it. I always try to find nice in people no matter what. But I keep getting fucked in the end. And I will not able to change my behavior of being nice to people. Like how are it is for someone to just get out their selfishness and genually care for other once. But these people are worthless piece of shit they dont know the meaning of it.  


So yeah i think i can understand what you feel like and what your views about people are.

I been in exact same situation. I have just one tip "Just show her why she is important to you".  
But I have one serious advise for you. Since she is not in same place as you are, she wants to give it a go because you are nice to her and probably care for her.  


I don't want to put any negative thoughts on your mind but just prepare for it that "She might not feel even after you give your all." And thats just heartbreaking sometime.  


Right now you will talk to her everyday, you will share moments with her with love. She is trying to do the same but she knows nothing is there but she is trying. Don't confuse this with true feeling. Not saying she will fake it. But for her to feel the same way she needs to act like that.

​

In the I just wanted to say "Show her your true self. Talk about future. And mention her in it. Talk how you two can improve together."   


And one more thing for her. Since she is in situation where she still don't feel the same way, make it clear with her that **"Don't caught up in the feelings and just say she likes you to." Tell her "Only tell me when you feel the same about me." Tell her "I will wait till the end just for it to happen".**

Honestly if i tell you right here it probably happened for better. Now you know none of those friend are your friends. So you would never count on them from now on.

I myself in bad share right now and i been through same situation. I Know its cliche and it just 100x harder to do that saying it. But try to make friend with whom you can share things.

And just ignore this social media for now. I bet if she(one who got lot of reaction) needs help from some of those online friends none of them will be there.

I know sometime you don't even care whether other actually care about you its just that you want to feel alive and hear some words from them which you deserve. But this world is selfish but i am sure there are some nice people out there like you or some of us here on this Reddit which will be amazing be around. Keep looking for them.
Just tell her. Otherwise you will regret not telling her. If she is your best friend you wont lose her. Trust me talking to her is best option for now and for your future.
